name: limit_fillet_on_a_shortened_edge
why: ENTRY E19, the bad twin. Same plan as the twin case, but in place of the hole a 5 x 45 chamfer on the top-front edge: the vertical edge of the corner is no longer 20 long but 15, and its midpoint goes down from z = 10 to z = 7.5. The edge the plan had seen IS NO LONGER THERE. The nearest one is — it is in the same corner — and taking it would be the worst defect: a fillet that succeeded on something the plan did not name. The search by signature wants the same length at the same point, and here it does not find it: it refuses.

steps._why_the_different_radius: 5 instead of the 8 of the twin: the refusal does not depend on the radius, and a refusal with arguments IDENTICAL to the twin does not prove the criterion (entry F5). Here the criterion is in the step before.

message_includes: I do not choose the closest one
